ns2:course.label: Reinforced Concrete I
ns2:course.description: Strength, behavior, and design of reinforced concrete members subjected to moments, shear, and axial forces; emphasis on the influence of the material properties on behavior. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: CEE 360.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: CEE 360.
